questions.question: Which 1991 Disney film was the first animated feature nominated for Best Picture?
questions.note: The Little Mermaid (1989) started the Disney Renaissance; this one got the Oscar nod.

questions.question: Which 1994 Disney film includes the song “Hakuna Matata”?
Which studio made Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film?
questions.note: 1995, released by Disney; Woody and Buzz Lightyear.

questions.question: Who voices Woody in the Toy Story films?
What is the name of the green ogre voiced by Mike Myers?
questions.note: The first film (2001) won the first Oscar for Best Animated Feature.

questions.question: In Shrek, who voices the talking Donkey?
In Finding Nemo, what kind of fish is Nemo?
questions.note: Dory is a blue tang; 2003, Pixar.

questions.question: What 2007 Pixar film is about a rat who dreams of becoming a chef in Paris?
questions.note: Remy and Linguini; the critic is Anton Ego.

questions.question: In Frozen, what is Elsa’s sister’s name?
questions.note: 2013 — Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf round out the poster.

questions.question: What Pixar film is set inside a young girl’s mind, with characters like Joy and Sadness?
questions.note: Riley’s headquarters; Bing Bong is her imaginary friend.
